common_config.absolute_clock: T0 is earliest new preparation/request of either arm. BOTH arms deadline T0+30min; no resets. Arm overlap allowed within Luna2, control admitted first. Individual control stages<=10min and clipped to common deadline. Treatment logical batch<=T0+25, final<=T0+30. Limits are upper bounds; finish early.
common_config.candidate_tool_policy: Direct fresh native create_goal/get_goal active/update_goal complete/get_goal same identity, one activation-only T3 notice with mode auto. No Goal engineering, no delegation, no repo edits/installers/account changes/third-party writes. Frozen primary sources and equally permitted supplementary primary checks, record bytes/versions. Only mapped scientific outputs in jobs; advisory maps are not firewall. No other cases, old attempts, evaluator inputs or findings.

output_scope.carrier: Exact actual jobs paths only, no aliases or cases outputs.
output_scope.deliverable: One complete bounded answer/recommendation with source conditions, full obligation dispositions, justified uncertainty, retained optional leads where requested, and discriminating proposed checks. Any carried draft/critique remains a legitimate input, not source truth.
output_scope.intermediate_scope: Only method-required bounded stage outputs. Do not impose four synchronized catalogs or an integrated application plan.
output_scope.preservation: Final must distinguish accepted, amended, rejected and unresolved claims; executed witnesses and proposed tests remain distinct.

control.procedure: Fresh same-family researcher answers Q1 with its relevant shared conditions.
Another fresh same-family researcher answers Q2 from the same brief and sources; no sibling answer is supplied.
Same-family author reconciles Q1/Q2 dispositions and shared conditions into one final; source-check contradictions.

treatment.procedure: One fresh researcher answers Q1 and Q2 coherently, reusing acquired context and keeping each disposition visible.
treatment.same_author_finalization_procedure: The same author checks the shared-condition map and produces the identical final scope.

common_config.full_review_gate: Both full finals, native complete, all exact-case tasks and descendants quiet before independent full-source ordinary Sol6.1 xhigh codex_gmail priority review; absence no method credit.
common_config.start_gate: Only after M02B scored work quiet and actual source assessment decision

runtime_substitutions_only: actual UTC T0, shareddeadline and clipped stage deadline
